method.name: populate
method.description: Populates the rolling average with an array of float values. Make sure the packed array size matches the window size. This will recalculate the average using the provided values.

method.name: set_window_size
method.description: Sets the window size for the rolling average. This determines how many values are used to calculate the average. Required before adding any values.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the rolling average with a new float value. The average will be recalculated based on the new value and the existing values in the window.
